votes.motion: Chair Cragun moved to TABLE the Election of Chair and Vice-Chair to the September 3, 2025, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Flynn seconded the motion
Commissioner Luker moved to APPROVE the Minutes of the July 2, 2025, Planning Commission Meeting, as presented. The motion was

Commissioner Flynn moved to APPROVE the Proposed Plat Amendment for the River Willow Estates Subdivision Lots 2 and 3 (Application 2025-10) based on the Findings presented in the Staff Report dated August 20, 2025. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Luker

Commissioner Luker moved to APPROVE the Proposed Plat Amendment for the Shane Parry Subdivision to Relocate a Shared Lot Line and Public Utility Easement (Application 2025-29) based on the Findings presented in the Staff Report dated August 20, 2025. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Flynn

Commissioner Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council for the Proposed Text of Section 11.80.010.110 Permissible Lot Coverage to increase the allowed Lot Coverage in the R-1-43 Zone from 30% to 35%, based on the findings presented in the Staff Report dated July 12, 2024. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Luker
Commissioner Flynn moved to forward a POSITIVE recommendation to the City Council for the Proposed 2025 Parks, Recreation, and Open Space Plan. The motion was seconded by Commissioner Luker
